pages.text: $(bold)Essential Crafting Recipes$()$(br2)Here are the key crafting recipes you'll need to create and interact with the girls in Pleasure Horizons. Each recipe serves a specific purpose in your journey.

pages.title: Fusion Table
pages.text: The magical table for fusing spawn eggs. Requires blaze powder, diamonds, ender pearls, and iron ingots.

pages.title: Magical Pumpkin
pages.text: Used to spawn custom girls when placed on white wool.

pages.title: Master Ring
pages.text: Used for capturing girls, even the wild ones, but you can't capture the one who already have owner.

pages.title: Love Ball
pages.text: Used for containing the girl you tamed, can't capture wild girl.

pages.title: Heart Guide
pages.text: This book! Contains all information about girls and mechanics.

pages.title: X-Pill
pages.text: A magical catalyst used in many recipes. Also transforms you into a girl. Use again to revert.

pages.title: Custom Girl Spawn Egg
pages.text: Create a homunculus-style custom girl from bones, leather, clay, an X-Pill, and an egg.

pages.title: Jenny Spawn Egg
pages.text: Summon the bold plains girl with gold ingots, a sunflower, an X-Pill, and an egg.

pages.title: Ellie Spawn Egg
pages.text: Summon the dark forest emo girl with ink sacs, black wool, a wither rose, an X-Pill, and an egg.

pages.title: Bia Spawn Egg
pages.text: Summon the magical teddy bear with brown wool, an X-Pill, and an egg.

pages.title: Aly Spawn Egg
pages.text: Summon the fairy girl with blue wool, cyan wool, diamonds, an X-Pill, and an egg.

pages.title: Slime Spawn Egg
pages.text: Summon the slime girl with slime balls, an X-Pill, and an egg.

pages.title: Kobold Spawn Egg
pages.text: Summon the cave-dwelling kobold with leather, coal, an X-Pill, and an egg.
